sections.title: Common Shopping User Roles
paragraphs: • Shops, then assigns ca rt to a requisitioner
• Does not need to know administrative details for procuring items (e.g., account codes, order distribution, payment method, tax, shipping and handling, discounts)
• Cannot submit an order; must assign to a requisitioner

sections.title: Approver: Common Permissions
paragraphs: • Can approve, return, or reject PRs and requests
• Approvals sometimes limited to department or business unit
• Can assign substitute and ad-hoc approvers

sections.title: Automating PR Population based on Prepared-for User
paragraphs: • You can set the system to automatically update custom field and address values based on the prepared-for user’s profile
• Requires default values set on the prepared-for user’s profile
Scenario: You need to prepare a requisition on someone else’s behalf.
1. Pick a user to create the PR for. Set default accounting codes and addresses in the user profile of that user.
2. Enable the setting that will update custom field and address values based on the prepared-for user.
3. Put an item in a cart and check out.
4. Change the Prepared-for fiel d on the requisition to that of the user you are purchasing on behalf of.

sections.title: Role vs. Profile: Punchout Access
paragraphs: Managed at the role or business unit level
• Access can be managed at the role or profile level
• Each currency must first be activated at the site level
• The default can be set at the site or BU level
• The default can be overridden on the profile

sections.title: Role vs. Profile: Permissions
paragraphs: • Creates a need to maintain individual records
• Creates a non- standardized set of users
Overriding permissions at the user level is not recommended!
• Defaults set at the role level
• Commonly, users are allowed to manage them thereafter

sections.title: Managing Changes to an Order
paragraphs: • A change to a PO NOT requiring that a PR go back through approval workflow
• Examples: incorrect supplier distribution information or change in an accounting code that does not affect approvals
• A change to a PO requiring that a PR go back through approval workflow
• Examples: change in item quantity or incorrect accounting code The updated PO can then be sent to the supplier or ERP if necessary
Elements that can be changed on a completed PO:

sections.title: Revising POs: Permissions
paragraphs: PO created & entered into PO workflow
CR created, changes made & CR submitted
Upon last approval, CR is merged back into PO
Revised PO may be sent back to supplier or ERP

sections.title: Be Aware:
paragraphs: • CR is possible only for POs that have not been fully invoiced (no matches).
• A PO cannot have a CR created if there is already a CR in a draf t or pending state for the PO.
• If PO doc config has been changed, CR will fail.
• Some ERPs do not support CRs.

sections.title: Change Request Permissions
paragraphs: • Send change request comments on a PO
• Create CRs for yourself and others
• Delete draft CRs for yourself and others
Guided Activity: Set Up Change Requests for Orders
1. Verify that change reques ts are enabled on your site.
3. Add PO revision and chan ge request permissions to the appropriate shoppe r and requisitioner roles.
4. Add appropriate change re quest notifications to shopper, requisitioner, and approver roles.
5. Find a PO to change, make the change, and submit the request.
6. View the approval status of the CR.

sections.title: What We’ll Discuss in this Lesson:
paragraphs: How do you configure ePro-related system notifications that go to suppliers and users?
• Manage system emails from the Administer menu and in Field Management
• How system emails are managed and modified
Automated Messaging System notifications are alerts that are sent out automatically when the certain events or triggers occur in the application.

sections.title: Notification Examples
paragraphs: • A cart has been assigned to you
• A requisition is pending approval and you are designated as a approver
• A requisition has exceeded the budget for that account code string.
• An error has occurred in a PO workflow step
• A new price file is pending review
• A contract is almost up for renewal
